race.description: Guardian Body Corporate Audit Services Plate (C3)
race.comment: INFLUENTIAL (9) is a handy gelding resuming and makes his stable debut for the in-form Jack Bruce yard. Tuned up with three trials and goes well when fresh. Maloney reunites and is 1/1 aboard. Bright return anticipated. COL BURN (7) made the perfect return here last month when getting the bob in a tit-for-tat battle to the line. Lightly raced and has plenty more to offer. Thompson sticking another push. RAZORS (4) made an encouraging impression first-up but knocked up quickly last time. Drops back in trip off a freshened but has been kept up to the mark with a trial win. Can improve sharply. CUTEPI (12) has been better in her last two. Could go either way for her from the inside but she's capable of giving this a shake on her best form.
